name: Keeby

surfaces.file: cover.png (app UI inside device-frame, partially cropped)
failures: #9 text contrast on translucent dark glass unverifiable at composite scale (insufficient-evidence)
#6/#12/#13 N/A — no paragraphs, text inputs, or form labels in a menu
native #9-equiv: colored orange menu-bar glyph vs classic monochrome template symbol (minor)

tokens.notes: deeper orange in hero app-icon keycap
menu selection binds to SYSTEM accent, not brand orange — accent discipline
flat warm-neutral; marketing surface only, not app bg
black capsule CTA — action black, orange stays jewelry
panel radius ~16-20px, soft floating shadow; glass-vs-solid indistinguishable (dark-glass humility)
matches macOS-27 kit menu selection radius 8
profile panel runs more generous custom cadence
custom 'Soon' badge on unreleased switch profiles

patterns.key_values: SwiftUI MenuBarExtra; titled sections (Control/Configure) of SF-Symbol-leading single-line items; selected item = full-width system-blue fill r~8 + white glyph + trailing chevron for submenus; ~24pt rows; ~160-170px panel width
keyboard-profile panel: header + rows of leading keycap glyph + label + trailing status (checkmark.circle active / gray 'Soon' capsule for upcoming); ~40-44pt rows; disabled-don't-remove
dark glass popover(s), ~16-20px corner radius, soft drop shadow, over live desktop; no window chrome/traffic lights (utility has no primary window)

signature_moves: Brand hue quarantined to the icon: loud orange identity but selection/focus/primary bind to system blue #0A84FF; even the marketing CTA is black, not orange
'Soon' status pills as a roadmap-in-the-menu — dimmed rows with a quiet gray capsule (disabled-don't-remove + honest anticipation), label never color-only
Menu-bar-extra is the entire app — no primary window; the architecture is the positioning (a background sound-layer you set and forget)
defects: Contrast Dilution (risk, unverifiable) — secondary gray headers + 'Soon' pills on translucent dark glass cannot be confirmed >=4.5:1 at composite scale; insufficient-evidence, not logged as confirmed defect
Colored menu-bar glyph — filled orange keycap vs classic monochrome template symbol that inherits menu-bar tint (mild, increasingly common)

aesthetic.direction: neo-grotesque consumer-utility with a single warm brand hue — orange-as-jewelry against neutral graphite/white, black high-contrast CTA; playful icon, disciplined chrome

psychology: Von Restorff / accent discipline — one system-blue selection and one black CTA are the only non-neutral action signals; orange is identity, not affordance
Jakob's Law — ships as a menu-bar extra, exactly where Mac users expect a lightweight background utility to live
Hick's Law — menu kept short and chunked into titled Control/Configure groups (few choices per decision point)
Zeigarnik / Goal-Gradient + honest scarcity — 'Soon' pills tease upcoming switch profiles without hiding them
Aesthetic-Usability + trust — flat neutral surface plus '$4.99 one-time purchase' microcopy near the CTA (anti-subscription trust signal)
notes: ONLY asset is a 1200x630 marketing cover; real app UI is inside a MacBook device-frame at the bottom and is partially cropped (menu's last row 'Position' cut off). All app-surface values are estimated with wide ranges and LOW confidence; backdrop/brand values are cleaner (measured). No light-mode, no settings/onboarding, no window chrome seen. Do NOT promote any Keeby observation toward canon from this single low-confidence composite — it can only corroborate. Functional twin of Klack — differentiate deliberately in any derived mock. Best next asset: a real @2x screenshot of the open menu + a light-mode capture. App icon (orange smiling keycap) is brand evidence only; icon digestion (Workflow B) was out of scope for this task.
